header.ended: Ended: the application HAP has not run on a device; install and launch stay unverified

sections.agentDecisions: Decided by the agent for you

environment.name: Environment
environment.description: Confirm the Qt for HarmonyOS distribution, HarmonyOS SDK and native toolchain, build/package tools and project template are in place, and prove them by building, deploying, packaging, signing and running a template app on a device; later phases reuse the verified environment as is.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.description: Scan sources and build files for the Qt modules, platform-specific code, system APIs and third-party libraries to migrate, each with an acceptance scenario.

decisions.name: Decisions
decisions.description: Ask the open questions, state the feasibility verdict, fill in the scope (app sources, app library, output project) and freeze the plan; removing, degrading or replacing a feature needs your answer.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.description: Audit the app's HarmonyOS build configuration and complete the first real build, then migrate features in dependency order: build third-party libraries and the app first, then make small source changes driven by the build results, each with a validation record.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Build, package, install and run the app on a device; each problem is one record (where, symptom, cause, fix) and is fixed before the phase closes.

features.name: Features
features.description: After the base Qt migration is done (the app builds, installs and launches), ask which registered HarmonyOS features to add (tap-to-transfer, continuation, share), then implement them one by one; passes right away when none are chosen.

validation.name: Validation
validation.description: Verify every acceptance scenario, check the final package contents and device runs, and write the migration report.

phase.rowsFracHint: Closed ledger rows. Whether the phase is done is decided by its gate, not by this count.
